Collect memories. Travel - doesn't have to be far. Take a book to a park and read. Swim in a lake. Try riding horses!

We are also building a truck from scratch to drive next year to FL. The same truck would cost 60+ thousand dollars new easy! But by doing the build ourselves we get exactly what we want and that first test drive in it will be so sweet!! I'm learning to drive a manual pickup, how to make knives from scratch, and I enjoy driving my horses through town. Life is grand ❤
